meta.name: code-reviewer
meta.description: Analyzes code diffs and files to identify bugs, security vulnerabilities (SQL injection, XSS, insecure deserialization), code smells, N+1 queries, naming issues, and architectural concerns, then produces a structured review report with prioritized, actionable feedback. Use when reviewing pull requests, conducting code quality audits, identifying refactoring opportunities, or checking for security issues. Invoke for PR reviews, code quality checks, refactoring suggestions, review code, code quality. Complements specialized skills (security-reviewer, test-master) by providing broad-scope review across correctness, performance, maintainability, and test coverage in a single pass.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查代码差异，发现漏洞、坏味道和架构问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码并给出结构化反馈
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code diffs to find bugs, vulnerabilities, and code smells
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review code and need structured feedback

howto.what: Claude 会分析代码差异和文件，找出 bug、安全漏洞（如 SQL 注入）、代码异味、N+1 查询等问题，然后输出按严重程度排序、带具体修复建议的审查报告。
howto.when: 当用户要求审查 pull request、检查代码质量或寻找重构机会时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个 PR，列出需要修改的问题。
say.note: 会生成包含问题清单的报告。

say.text: 检查这段代码有没有 SQL 注入和 N+1 查询。
say.note: 会逐项检查安全与查询性能。

say.text: 给我一份代码审查报告，按严重程度排序。
say.note: 会输出按优先级排列的反馈。

howto.what_en: Analyzes code diffs and files for bugs, security issues, code smells, and N+1 queries, then produces a structured, prioritized review report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to review a pull request, check code quality, or find refactoring opportunities.

say_en.text: Review this PR and list what needs to be fixed.
say_en.note: Produces a report with a list of issues.
